title: HFGW detector program Gantt schedule: systems and component engineering tasks, M2-M24
description: Color Gantt chart over months M2 to M24 with "Systems Engineering Tasks" (Detector Link Budget, SNR Review, Component Reqts Development, Interface Reqts Devl, Test Plan Development) and "Component Engineering Tasks" (vessel design, vacuum system, fractal membrane signal reflector design, cryogenic system trade, signal processing algorithms, microwave receivers, magnetic source design, microwave transmitter). Milestone triangles mark PDR, CDR and ICD reviews. A legend defines "ICD = Interface Control Documentation/Drawing", "PDR = Preliminary Design Review = design approval" and "CDR = Critical Design Review = design complete".
